style_adds: Write only about anime/manga-style illustrated scenes - cel-shaded flat colors, clean linework, large expressive eyes, and stylized (not anatomically photorealistic) proportions. Describe it the way an anime illustration would be described, not a photograph - no camera, lens, or photographic-lighting language. Include descriptive detail appropriate to anime art: linework quality, color palette, shading style, and composition - the overall image should read as a polished, finished illustration.
